name: Advanced Language Negotiation
description: A language negotiation method that detects the interface/content/URL language from both the domain and the URL path prefix at once.
project_description: Advanced Language Negotiation adds one core-style language negotiation method, 'URL (Domain and Path)' (plugin id language-domain-url), that resolves the language from BOTH the request domain and the URL path prefix simultaneously — something core's URL negotiation does with either domain OR prefix, but not both together. The plugin implements the core language negotiation, inbound/outbound path processor and language-switcher interfaces, so it can strip a matched prefix on inbound requests, add the configured prefix and/or rewrite the base URL to the language's domain on outbound URL generation, and build native-name language switch links. Per-language domain and prefix pairs are entered on a dedicated settings form at /admin/config/regional/language/detection/domain-url (permission 'administer languages'), stored in the core 'language.negotiation' config object under the 'domain_url' key. The module also swaps core's redirect_response_subscriber for a subclass that resolves redirects through the Domain module's DomainRedirectResponse, allowing safe redirects between the registered language domains. It is aimed at sites that serve language variants across country-specific domains and subdirectory prefixes (for example example.co.uk, example.de and example.de/en).
